meta.title: Your forest writing — Daily Page
meta.description: Browse the posts represented by trees in your private Activity Forest.

forestWriting.heading: Your writing grove
forestWriting.introduction: Every tree holds a piece of writing you’ve made. Choose one to revisit the post it grew from.

inclusion.hidden: The tree was hidden from your forest.
inclusion.conflict: This tree changed elsewhere. Reload the page and try again.
inclusion.unavailable: The tree could not be updated right now. Please try again.

forestWriting.omitted: {count} tree could not be shown because its current writing is unavailable.

reconciling.heading: Your forest is growing
reconciling.body: We are checking your writing and preparing an up-to-date forest. Please return shortly.

empty.heading: No writing trees to show yet
empty.notEstablished: Your private forest has not been established yet.
empty.ready: No currently eligible, visible writing is represented in your forest.
empty.hidden: You have not hidden any currently eligible writing trees.

invalid.heading: That forest page is not available
invalid.body: The page link was invalid or has expired.

unavailable.heading: Your forest is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not safely load this view. Please try again later.

marked.heading: Your marked writing
marked.introduction: Revisit the places you chose to remember a piece of writing.
marked.unavailableBody: This marker remains in your forest. Its writing cannot be opened right now.
marked.empty: You have not marked a writing tree yet.
marked.conflict: This marker changed elsewhere. Reload the page and try again.
marked.error: The marker could not be removed. Please try again.
marked.confirm: Remove this marker from your forest? The writing will remain.
